replies.body:
Hello.

Here is your evidence:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HNLVnFe_BOE
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gUUoQ1ufyNE

About video 1:

"If you set the speed of the second part of the video to 0.25, you clearly see that his aim assistance moved towards the head of the left player, and while the left player was jumping, also Arcane_Horror's Aim assistance followed his jump. After he got knocked away, you can see his Aim assistance following the head of the target in the exactly same way as before. This cannot be human. He could not have faked AimBot."

About video 2:

"It's pretty obvious that he used Bow AimBot. You can't move your head that quick directly to the skin of another player, it's just not human."

replies.author: Arcane_Horror
replies.body:
Aimbot:
If you look closely... I didn't even look at the dude to my left. My aim wasn't inside their hitbox. easy.
The reason I initially turned towards the guy to my left was because I was getting hit, and instinct took over. 
But then I realized I might be able to knock the armored guy off the ledge so I turned back. Too bad I failed.

Bowaimbot:
Oh wow this actually legit looks like bowaimbot. I didn't know I had this fast reflexes. Damn I'm good.
I really can't say what happened here, since I don't remember lol.

When I originally looked at my teammate, I probably thought that Blaze might not have gotten kb form the hits he took cus lag maybe, therefore I assumed Blaze to be about at the spot where my teammate was. Or maybe I just played it safe.
When I realized he got knocked, I turned to him. I don't really know why I didn't concentrate on Blaze more, but I guess I assumed he would have taken enough damage from the original hits to die from the fall damage.

Now to the aimbot part. I have absolutely no idea why I turned to my teammate. Since everything was going so fast maybe I thought my teammate who hit Blaze was an enemy. I don't think this was the case though.
However, if you look at the ending, you can see that there are arrows firing from the right corner, about where my teammate was. Maybe I saw those arrows and assumed it might have been enemy fire and so I turned
to the direction that the arrows were firing from, which, in turn, also happened to be where my teammate was. It's hard to really tell what happened though.
Now about it being impossible to turn that fas- bullshit. The range of motion was so short that it is, in my eyes at least, absolutely possible to turn that fast. You can try it for yourself.

Now lastly, the part where I aimed back at the teammate. This I cannot give an accurate answer for. I might have thought that blaze didn't die yet, so maybe I turned back (however I have no idea why I turned at my teammate, maybe I still
thought that Blaze was in the air, at the same spot as my teammate? dunno, seems unlikely). The reason I followed his head was probably because that's just what I sometimes do. Sometimes I like to aim at my teammates for fun or something,
I can't give any better answer than that. 
EDIT: Dunno if it's too late for edits to matter at this point, but I want to say that at the very ending where I turned back at my teammate, that was simply because the situation was over and I decided to go back to spawn. I just happened not to put my bow out before doing so. I seemed to have miscalculated where the exact entrance to spawn was so I coincidentally turned at my teammate.
If this appeal gets denied, I just want you to know that regardless of the I guess valid evidence, I never cheated and probably never will.

-Arcane_Horror aka fagzer153 (get it?)
